In this video, we break down the Varun Dhawan podcast trailer from @ranveerallahbadia episode 338 to show you how to craft a high-impact podcast trailer from scratch. Whether you're just learning how to start video editing, or looking for fresh podcast trailer ideas, this guide is packed with everything you need!
From the tone of a podcast trailer, to the perfect sound effects and background music, we analyze what makes this trailer work so well and how you can apply the same tricks. Plus, we offer a podcast trailer template to help structure your own!
What You'll Learn:
1. How to make a podcast trailer that grabs attention?
2. What to say in a podcast trailer to hook your audience?
3. Examples of podcast trailers that work.
4. The role of music and sound design in podcast intros.
5. Video editing tips for beginners.
